title: Drop the private case
summary: This meets the mind that wants peace without giving up its self-importance. The line says doubt clears when selfishness loosens inside true company.
takeaway: Lay down selfishness and rejoin peace.
lifeApplication: Before reopening the argument in your head, sit down among the truthful and stop defending the old position. Let one honest word dissolve the case you keep building.

source.shortMeaning: True company loosens selfishness, and peace returns without inner bargaining.
source.lifeApplication: Before another inner argument, move toward company that can tell you the truth.

evidence.coreClaim: True company loosens selfishness, and peace returns without inner bargaining.
evidence.turn: Doubt clears when the Guru's word outlasts wandering.
